title: The Lost One's Shadow
text: A shadow walks the road ahead of you with no one casting it, long and thin in the noon sun. It has the shape of one of your Lost: the slump of the shoulders, the hitch in the step. It stops when you stop. It does not turn around.

options.label: Follow the shadow where it walks, trusting it knows the way.

outcomes.text: Without ever turning, it walks you to the place where it was lost.
It walks you to what took it, then vanishes. The thing does not.

options.label: The wisest speaks to the shadow, hoping some part of them is still listening.

outcomes.text: It does not answer. It only lifts an arm that is not there to point toward the hills, and its cold stays with you.

options.label: It is an ill omen. Go around it; do not let it lead you.

outcomes.text: It waits by the road as you pass, its head turning to follow you though it has no face to turn.
